title: A page per changelog entry
summary: Tapping an entry opens it on its own, with a link of its own whose preview stays fixed when newer entries land.

title: Changelog page
summary: This page: one entry per merged pull request, newest first, built from changelog.json. Its link preview shows the latest change.

title: § 18 renamed to No Non-Consensual Content
summary: The rule gets a definition in § 18.1 and no longer leans on a word that can bring back past experiences. The banned tag is now NonCon.

title: § 18: consent in content
summary: Non-consensual content is banned and consensual non-consent (CNC) is allowed. Whether anyone in the piece is shown suffering decides between open, controlled and banned. The controlled list gains a CNC entry.

title: Pacific Northwest section
summary: A new Sections group opens with a Pacific Northwest page: the PNW Furs Telegram link and the Seattle Fur/Pup and Gay Seattle calendars, embedded live. PNW Furs is also listed among the chats on the Welcome page.

title: Stephie the Deer and Neceet are banned
summary: The character Stephie the Deer and the artist Neceet join the banned list for cub.

title: A page for every controlled entry
summary: Clicking a name on Banned & Controlled opens its profile, and each entry has its own page under /controlled/ whose link preview states the reason.

title: Lugiem is banned
summary: The artist Lugiem joins the banned list for cub.

title: VRChat Moderation team
summary: Cirrus heads the new team; Jericho and Haskell moderate.

title: VRChat group on the Welcome page
summary: The VRChat group is listed among the network's chats.

title: Cirrus co-heads Discord Moderation
summary: A team can have more than one Head Admin; Cirrus joins Discord Moderation as one.

title: AshenDerg entry approved; Klauth joins Telegram Moderation
summary: Staff approval of the AshenDerg beware is recorded. Klauth joins Telegram Moderation as an admin.

title: AshenDerg invites into the channel
summary: The beware records that AshenDerg invites people into the channel; ownership of it is not established.

title: AshenDerg beware
summary: AshenDerg, a second identity of RuneDerg, gets a beware entry with an aliases row and is banned.

title: Repository conventions
summary: Housekeeping: contributor conventions, a directory map, and CI split into format, lint and test checks.

title: Patel evidence anonymized
summary: The other party in Patel's evidence appears as Member at their request, with typed transcripts in place of screenshots. § references in Bans and Bewares now link to the clause.

title: Bewares: a page per person
summary: Bewares becomes an overview with a page per person. Patel's entry describes the recurring self-harm tactic and the deflection of blame, with the exported DM transcript as evidence.

title: Basil on five more teams
summary: Basil is added to five more moderation teams.

title: Bewares page
summary: A new Bewares page for behaviour patterns the team has verified, starting with Patel.

title: CatShark TreeHouse on the Welcome page
summary: The chat is renamed CatShark TreeHouse and the Telegram and Discord links point at the new places.

title: Incident 260819 statement
summary: The statement on incident 260819 is published.

title: The wiki launches
summary: The Network Rules become numbered clauses with an amendment log and gain § 1.5, § 2.5, § 2.6, § 4.4, § 4.5, § 13 and § 17. New pages: Moderation Strategy, incident 260819, the ban register, the staff roster with team charts, and Banned & Controlled as a static list edited through pull requests (spoilered becomes controlled). Every page shows its revision history, the site wears the gold and charcoal theme, and it deploys to GitHub Pages. The Telegram bot and API are retired.

title: CI on Node 22
summary: Housekeeping: the checks run on Node 22.

title: Project created
summary: The repository starts with a Rust backend, the Astro site and CI.
